# Algorithm version 1 regression fixtures

`algorithm-v1.json` records dimensions, SHA-256 hashes of raw RGBA bytes, and
ASCII text captured from the production algorithm implementation **before** its
extraction into these packages. The source digest identifies that snapshot.
These expected values are not generated by the packages under test.

Inputs are reproducible synthetic gradients, mixed alpha values, seeded noise,
and a transparent pixel, defined in `images.mjs`. Each style also has a case with
its most demanding supported options. No user images or application configuration
are included.

These fixtures protect byte-for-byte behavior during extraction and maintenance.
Do not refresh them merely to make a failing test pass. An intentional visual
change must document its effect and consider changing `ALGORITHM_VERSION`.

The unit suite additionally checks visual properties independently of the hashes.
The Worker smoke test compares final package output in real `workerd` with Node
output, using maximum-size images, edge dimensions, and malformed input.
